- [Contrastive PCA++ (cPCA++) Performs Contrastive PCA++ (cPCA++) to find directions that capture variation enriched in a "foreground" dataset relative to a "background" dataset. This implementation follows the cPCA++ approach which directly solves the generalized eigenvalue problem Rf v = lambda Rb v, where Rf and Rb are the covariance matrices of the foreground and background data, centered using the *background mean*.](https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/multivarious/blob/master/docs/reference/cPCAplus.md)
